audit.why: Early/mid lane favours Pantheon (Azir has no escape pre-E and is squishy); side lane and teamfights flip to Azir at two items — the page already states this in content late/spikes[3].
Spikes correctly listed: 3-5 all-in, 6 Grand Starfall dive, 1st item, then Azir's two-item takeover. spikes[] has all 4 entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers; the level chart's last row said Pantheon on the full layer while content and prose say Azir; Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim.
audit.why: Azir E Shifting Sands is 22s at rank 1 (16 max), Q is 14s early — real windows the advice should cite. Azir R Emperor's Divide knocks back and its soldier wall blocks paths, which shoves a diving Pantheon out — the correct late-game reason.
audit.corrected: See edits: cooldowns rewritten with real numbers, phases[6] moved to Azir with matching why/rating (win[6] already reads Azir), bleed bullets replaced with kit-grounded advice.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Two-plus items Azir kites your combo behind soldiers and Emperor's Divide shoves your dive back out — the lane's window has closed.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Aegis Assault like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — a 22-second cooldown at rank 1 (16 at max). Once the shield-dash is burned, you own the next twenty seconds. - His Q is 14s early: trade right after the soldiers move. - Guard your E Aegis Assault (22s) like a fifth summoner. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: At level 2 Azir has no dash yet — W the step-up and he eats the full combo with no answer but Flash.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: After his first item his soldiers out-trade you at 525 soldier range — walk up only to all-in off W, never to answer soldier chip.
